description: Envelope follower with a gate output, tracking the size of whatever is patched in

params.text: Sets how quickly the envelope climbs as the signal grows, 1ms to 2 seconds
Sets how quickly the envelope falls as the signal shrinks, 1ms to 2 seconds
Sets the level the envelope has to pass for the gate to go high, 0V to 8V, with 0.8V of hysteresis either side

inputs.text: The signal being followed; it is rectified first, so a negative swing counts for as much as a positive one

outputs.text: 8V while the envelope is above the threshold and 0V while it is below
